item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We oppose commercial deep-sea mining because it will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. The ocean floor is a living world, not an industrial sacrifice zone. We must protect it before extraction begins.

2. We cannot replace deep-ocean ecosystems once mining destroys them. We reject a future that trades irreplaceable life for minerals. We demand protection for the deep sea—not permission to tear it apart.

3. We will not accept permanent ocean destruction as the price of progress. Commercial deep-sea mining will destroy deep-ocean ecosystems forever. We stand for keeping these living habitats intact and mining machines out.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a choice that will shape the ocean’s future: protect the deep sea or open it to permanent destruction. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, it will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. We refuse to treat that loss as an acceptable cost of doing business. We see the ocean floor as a living world worth defending, not a stockpile waiting to be extracted. Our commitment is clear: we will oppose commercial deep-sea mining and demand lasting protection for these irreplaceable habitats. Together, we can insist that progress means finding better ways to meet our needs—not destroying ecosystems we can never bring back.
